### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

The OWASP Amass Project performs network mapping of attack surfaces and external asset discovery using open source information gathering and active reconnaissance techniques. > You can find additional installation instructions and documentation in the [Amass Docs](https://owasp-amass.github.io/docs) repo. We are always happy to get new contributors on board!
